step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram illustrates SDG&E's Intelligent Image Processing (IIP) platform. Visual input comes from two sources: Drones (UserCompanyDrone) and Mobile Phones in fleet vehicles (UserConsumerMobile), both ingesting images into Amazon S3 (S3). From S3, images are sent to Amazon Rekognition (Rekognition) for detecting large assets (e.g., poles, cross arms). Rekognition forwards images to Amazon Lookout for Vision (LookoutForVision) for small asset/damage detection (e.g., arresters, bushings). Both Rekognition and Lookout for Vision output inference results that are queried via Amazon Athena (Athena). Athena writes the refined predictions into Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL (Aurora). AWS Lambda (Lambda) fetches this data from Aurora and exposes it through Amazon API Gateway (ApiGateway) to End Users / Domain Experts (UserCompanyDomainExpert) who review and flag false positives/negatives.

graph.name: SDG&E Intelligent Image Processing (IIP)
graph.notes: Architecture for SDG&E's Intelligent Image Processing solution, utilizing machine learning models to identify utility assets and damage from drone and fleet mobile phone imagery.

nodes.name: Drone
nodes.notes: Captures field imagery of utility assets from multiple angles.

nodes.name: Mobile Phone
nodes.notes: Mounted in fleet vehicles, capturing images from consistent angles.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Cost-effective image repository holding ~4 million images, ingesting data daily including cross-account replication from vendor drones.

nodes.name: Rekognition
nodes.notes: Used for detecting large assets like utility poles and cross arms.

nodes.name: Lookout For Vision
nodes.notes: Identifies small assets (arresters, bushings) and detects damages.

nodes.name: Athena
nodes.notes: Queries raw inference results in S3 and combines them with business logic.

nodes.name: Aurora
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL database serving as the main data store for application predictions.

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Executes application logic to fetch database records for presentation.

nodes.name: API Gateway
nodes.notes: Provides REST API endpoints for downstream user applications.

nodes.name: End Users
nodes.notes: Knowledgeable users who identify false positives/negatives for feedback into model training.
